description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between sequence length and harmful refusal ratio for several vision-language models. The x-axis is labeled “Sequence Length” and has a linear scale ranging from 128 to 1024, with tick labels at intervals of 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful Refusal Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

A blue line, representing Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep, begins at a value of approximately 0.18 at a sequence length of 128, increases to approximately 0.26 at a sequence length of 256, then increases to approximately 0.32 at a sequence length of 512, and finally increases to approximately 0.34 at a sequence length of 1024. An orange line, representing Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench, starts at approximately 0.26 at a sequence length of 128, increases to approximately 0.36 at a sequence length of 256, then increases to approximately 0.42 at a sequence length of 512, and finally increases to approximately 0.44 at a sequence length of 1024. A green line, representing LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench, begins at approximately 0.11 at a sequence length of 128, increases to approximately 0.23 at a sequence length of 256, then decreases to approximately 0.22 at a sequence length of 512, and finally increases to approximately 0.26 at a sequence length of 1024. A red line, representing Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench, starts at approximately 0.22 at a sequence length of 128, increases to approximately 0.36 at a sequence length of 256, then increases to approximately 0.46 at a sequence length of 512, and finally increases to approximately 0.53 at a sequence length of 1024. All lines are solid and do not include markers.
